claim: Actual nonnegative-supermartingale all-natural-time crossing bound used by P81
review_kind: Separate-agent raw-source review within the same collaborative model session, not an independent external referee.
reviewer_authorship: Reviewer authored none of VilleInequality.lean; reviewer consumes its endpoint in P81.

claim_card.hypotheses: An arbitrary probability sample space and Nat filtration; an actual real-valued Supermartingale M; pointwise nonnegativity at every time/sample; actual initial integral<=1; positive real crossing threshold c.
claim_card.objects: Literal finite and all-natural-time crossing events, actual bounded hitting time and stopped value.
claim_card.conclusion: The literal crossing event is measurable and has measure<=ofReal(1/c). The same bound applies to any selected natural-time crossing subset.
claim_card.scope: No Gaussian mixture, confidence event, adapted process construction or initial-expectation bound is assumed as the crossing conclusion; those remain inputs to be proved separately by the P81 application.

obligations.evidence: crossingUpTo_measurable and crossing_measurable express literal crossing sets as countable unions of measurable threshold events derived from actual Supermartingale strong adaptedness.
tau is literally hittingBtwn on [0,N], embedded in WithTop Nat; actual stopping-time property follows from adaptedness, and hittingBtwn_le proves its deterministic finite upper bound.

The proof applies expected_stoppedValue_mono to the actual submartingale -M, constant initial time0 and tau. Negating both integrals gives E[M_tau]<=E[M_0]. Its hypotheses and inequality orientation match the local Mathlib theorem.

integrable_stoppedValue is derived from actual Supermartingale integrability and bounded tau. On each finite crossing, the stopped value is at least c by stoppedValue_hittingBtwn_mem. Pointwise process nonnegativity also controls stopped values outside the crossing event, so its set integral is at most its full integral.

setIntegral_ge_of_const_le_real uses the actual finite measure and measurable crossing event. c>0 is supplied before le_div_iff. Probability measure finiteness justifies conversion between real measure and ENNReal.ofReal.
crossingUpTo is proved monotone in N and its increasing union is exactly the all-natural-time crossing event. measure_iUnion and iSup_le transfer the uniform finite bound with no missing tail event.
Time0 and N0 are included. The initial process value may itself be random; only its actual expectation is bounded. No assumption that M0 is pointwise1 is silently used.

selected_time_bound uses literal subset containment in the measurable all-time event. No t measurability is asserted in that generic theorem; for arbitrary t its measure expression is the outer measure and the inequality remains valid. P81 can use the stronger pathwise simultaneous event.

The control constructs a genuine constant-two Supermartingale and rejects the incorrect half-probability crossing conclusion when the initial-integral budget is dropped. Reviewer rerun yields exactly one intended unsolved False.

reviewer_checks.scope: Author replay marker inspected; not independently repeated by reviewer.

strongest_safe_statement: The actual generic Ville crossing theorem as written, for arbitrary probability spaces, actual nonnegative Nat-indexed Supermartingales and an initial integral budget, is supported.
